lucky.brush.title: LUCKY BRUSH!
lucky.brush.subtitle: Your brush turned lucky ☘
lucky.power.chain_lightning.desc: Every hit: a green bolt chains through 6 mobs. 1 in 5 chance of JACKPOT (x3 damage).
lucky.power.phantom_dash.desc: Right click: lightning-fast charge through a tunnel of rings that shreds everything.
lucky.power.jackpot_rail.desc: Fully drawn: 110-block piercing beam, explodes on impact.
lucky.power.black_hole.desc: Sneak + fully drawn: a portal black hole sucks everything in, then collapses in a giant explosion.
lucky.power.green_tornado.desc: Right click: a cyclone of green flames advances, pulls, ignites and tears up the scenery.
lucky.power.meteor_rain.desc: Sneak + right click: 16 green meteors crash onto the targeted area.
lucky.power.spherical_quake.desc: Right click a block: the ground implodes, then a 5.5-block sphere is pulverized.
lucky.power.drill.desc: Sneak + right click: bores a 3.5-wide tunnel 48 blocks long.
lucky.power.tidal_wave.desc: Right click: a wall of energy plows 24 blocks of terrain and flings everything.
lucky.power.gravity_slam.desc: Sneak + right click: leap, then a crushing dive that digs a 7-block crater.
lucky.power.lucky_aura.desc: Passive: per-piece effects. Full set: Strength II, Resistance and orbiting clovers.
lucky.power.jackpot_nova.desc: Full set, sneak 2 s: 24-block shockwave, lightning and 10 s of overpower.
lucky.power.lucky_brush.desc: Every brushed suspicious block gives a cheat item.
lucky.power.lucky_brush.desc2: Every 3 blocks: a custom Lucky item!
